H,W=27,23
g=[[8]*W for _ in range(H)]
frames=[(1,5,1,11,2,2),(7,11,1,11,4,4),(13,17,1,11,3,1),(19,23,1,11,1,1)] # row bounds incl, border color, count dots
for r0,r1,c0,c1,col,n in frames:
    for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r0][c]=g[r1][c]=col
    for r in range(r0,r1+1): g[r][c0]=g[r][c1]=col
    mr=(r0+r1)//2
    for c in range(c1-2*n, c1, 2): g[mr][c]=col
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
